conditions.evidence: Rule 22200029 inspects attacker-controlled REQUEST_URI, applies lowercase/urlDecode/trim, and blocks author=[0-9]+; README says the disabled setting blocks /?author=1, test Dockerfile sets it to 0, and CI expects 403.

rationale: Security-boundary WAF with a concrete shape-3 property candidate: determine whether any documented numeric author URI can evade rule 22200029 when user enumeration is disabled. The exact-pin README, Docker test setup, and CI provide the trust boundary and expected block behavior.
